One row per RFC that the [RFC Editor's index](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc-index.xml) lists with a plain-text format, read in bulk at stage S2: its index metadata and how many BCP 14 requirements the mechanical extraction finds in its text, by level. Nothing here is reviewed. Obsoleted by and Updated by link each RFC that has a row; Requirements reads `none` when the extraction finds no BCP 14 keyword; Profile names each profile of the [protocol catalogue](/docs/catalog) whose lock holds the RFC, linked to its page, where its requirements are reviewed.
